148:t_017:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I understand! That machine cannot be allowed to exist!」

148:t_017:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm using $$トランザムバースト$$!」

148:t_018:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$! We've found out that your machine scatters nanomachines that damage both machines and pilots!」

148:t_018:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The high-density particles of $$トランザムバースト$$ can shut that function down too!」

148:t_020:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Our minds are melting together!」

148:t_020:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The power of the GN particles and the $$サイコ・フレーム$$...!」

148:t_022:2.en:
$n
「Thank you, Captain $$アムロ$$... Thanks to your words, I... was able to break his poison...」

148:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Was my voice the only one you heard?」

148:t_022:4.en:
$n
「Besides that... I think I heard Miss $$スズネ$$'s voice...」

148:t_022:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you all right, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

148:t_022:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Y-yes... I was almost unconscious, so I'm not really sure, but...」

148:t_022:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
(So she has no memory of that time...)

148:t_022:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...I don't like this, $$いがみ合う双子$$...」

148:t_023:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even with your comrades' help, I can't accept you breaking my poison.」

148:t_023:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh dear... this is about to get bad...」

148:t_023:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$サルディアス$$... You stand back.」

148:t_023:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, sir~. I'll do just that this time.」

148:t_024:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... And $c... The real battle starts here.」

148:t_025:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$アンタレス$$ and I will take you on...」

148:t_025:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「And we'll burn everything in this city to ashes!」

148:t_025:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That mental attack on $n just now...! Did you amplify the hatred toward me?」

148:t_025:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right. But my power doesn't create something from nothing.」

148:t_025:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「They hated you in their hearts! Don't forget that, $$ゼロ$$!」

148:t_025:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I've known that for a long time.」

148:t_025:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And I know that no matter what I do, I can never atone for my sins...!」

148:t_025:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「But even so, we fight! For the people who entrusted their tomorrow to $$ゼロ$$!」

148:t_025:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's the only thing we can do!」

148:t_025:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think that kind of self-satisfaction can beat my hatred, you trash!」

148:t_026:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is dangerous.」

148:t_026:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But if we take him down, the $$サイデリアル$$ should pull back...! This is our chance!」

148:t_026:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America... We had no choice but to retreat before that man's power.」

148:t_026:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But if the forces of $$新日本$$ join us...」

148:t_026:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, can you hear me? Judging from how long we can keep fighting, six more minutes is our limit.」

148:t_026:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can't defeat that man by then...」

148:t_026:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we win within those six minutes...! All units, concentrate your attacks on him!」

148:t_026:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Be very careful of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! That machine is forming a special field around itself!」

148:t_026:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So that's the $$スフィア・アクト$$ we've heard about...!」

148:t_026:15.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems that power differs from Reactor to Reactor.」

148:t_026:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「Give it everything you've got! If we could defeat $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$, we can do this!」

148:t_026:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You will all taste hell for six minutes.」

148:t_027:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is dangerous.」

148:t_027:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But if we take him down, the $$サイデリアル$$ should pull back...! This is our chance!」

148:t_027:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The assault on $$セントラル・ベース$$ in North America... We had no choice but to retreat before that man's power.」

148:t_027:4.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「But if the forces of $$新日本$$ join us...」

148:t_027:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, can you hear me? Judging from how long we can keep fighting, five more minutes is our limit.」

148:t_027:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If we can't defeat that man by then...」

148:t_027:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we win within those five minutes...! All units, concentrate your attacks on him!」
